newsitem.title: USA: Hayes Wheels to supply wheels to Ford.
newsitem.headline: Hayes Wheels to supply wheels to Ford.

text.p: Hayes Wheels International Inc said Wednesday it has received a contract from Ford Motor Co to supply wheels for its Ranger pickup truck, beginning with the 1998 model year.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
The wheels will be produced at Hayes Wheels' manufacturing facilities in Sedalia, Mo., and Gainesville, Ga. Shipment is expected to begin in the second half of 1997.

As a result of this contract, as well as other recent contracts from various original equipment manufacturers, Hayes Wheels said it is making significant capital investments in both facilities. The company will invest $20 million in its Gainesville facility, which will increase the plant's size by 88,000 square feet and its production capacity by about 50 percent. In 1995, Hayes Wheels announced that it would invest $22 million in new equipment for the Sedalia plant, and now plans to increase the plant's size by 110,000 square feet and its production capacity by more than 25 percent.
Hayes Wheels designs, engineers and makes steel and aluminum wheels and brake drums and rotors for the automotive and commercial highway markets in North America, Europe and Asia.
